The '''75th Directors Guild of America Awards''', honoring the outstanding directorial achievement in feature [[Film director|films]], [[Documentary film|documentary]], [[Television director|television]] and [[Television advertisement|commercials]] of 2022, were presented on February 18, 2023, at [[the Beverly Hilton]] in [[Beverly Hills, California]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Tapp |first1=Tom |title=DGA Awards: Daniel Kwan & Daniel Scheinert Win for ''Everything Everywhere All At Once'' – Complete Winners List |url=https://deadline.com/2023/02/dga-awards-winners-list-2-1235263721/ |website=Deadline |access-date=February 19, 2023 |date=February 18, 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite press release |author=<!--Not stated--> |title= 75th Annual DGA Awards Winners|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2023/220312_75th_Annual_DGA_Awards_Winners.aspx |location=Los Angeles |publisher=[[Directors Guild of America]] |agency= |date=February 18, 2023 |access-date=February 19, 2023}}</ref> The ceremony was hosted by [[Judd Apatow]], who previously hosted the [[70th Directors Guild of America Awards|ceremonies in 2018]], [[72nd Directors Guild of America Awards|2020]] and [[74th Directors Guild of America Awards|2022]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Verhoeven |first1=Beatrice |title=Judd Apatow to Return as Host of 2023 DGA Awards |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/judd-apatow-host-2023-dga-awards-1235303587/ |access-date=February 19, 2023 |work=The Hollywood Reporter |date=January 19, 2023}}</ref> The nominations for the television and documentary categories were announced on January 10, 2023,<ref>{{cite news |last1=Schneider |first1=Michael |title=''Severance'', ''Station Eleven'', ''The Daily Show'' Lead 2023 DGA Awards Television Nominations |url= https://variety.com/2023/tv/news/severance-station-eleven-2023-dga-awards-tv-nominations-1235484034/|access-date=January 10, 2023 |work=Variety |date=January 10, 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=DGA Announces Nominees for Outstanding Directorial Achievement in Television, Commercials and Documentary for 2022 |url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2023/230110_75thAnnualDGAAwardsTelevisionNomineesAnnounced.aspx |publisher=Directors Guild of America |access-date=January 10, 2023 |date=January 10, 2023}}</ref> while the nominations for the feature film categories were announced on January 11, 2023.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Pedersen |first1=Erik |title=DGA Awards Film Nominations: Steven Spielberg, Martin McDonagh, Todd Field, Joseph Kosinski & The Daniels Vying for Top Prize |url=https://deadline.com/2023/01/2023-dga-awards-nominations-film-nominees-1235218262/ |website=Deadline 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Chapman |first1=Wilson |title=75th DGA Awards Set for February 2023, Key Dates Announced |url=https://variety.com/2022/film/news/dga-awards-dates-2023-1235322318/
